what: PPL delivers electricity in Pennsylvania, Kentucky, Virginia and Rhode Island, delivers gas in Kentucky and Rhode Island, and generates power in Kentucky. It is a regulated utility holding company.
customers: Households, businesses and industrial users across four states.
money: electricity delivery to about 1.4 million customers
moat: Delivery monopolies in each state, with returns set by regulators and demand that does not depend on the economy as much as most businesses.
risks: Return on invested capital of about 5% is low, as is normal for a regulated utility
Rate case decisions determine recoverable investment
Pennsylvania and Kentucky regulators have different and sometimes conflicting priorities
opportunities: Revenue grew about 7% last year with a 24% operating margin
Data centre requests in Pennsylvania and Kentucky raise long-term demand
Capital investment plans keep increasing the base it earns on
watch: Data centre connection agreements and rate case outcomes.
